vb_textbox.text: I didn't find a particular pattern with the gnomes - there was no rhyme or reason with the number of mushrooms they collected. I attempted a strategy where if one gnome scored low, I'd switch to another but it didn't seem to make a difference. In the end, I just ended up selecting one every time as it was easier to press that key on the keyboard! The other piece of advice i'd give is to press the space bar multiple times as I sometimes ended up being too slow.
